limits.value: billed per minute on provisioned resources: $0.00125 a minute for a 2 vCPU, 8 GB runner
premium runners fall back to standard ones when capacity is full, with no extra wait

evidence.proved: 'Billing is based on the resources provisioned, pro-rated for the time they are provisioned. We calculate resource consumption at per minute granularity and bill monthly.' with the GitHub Actions table '2 vCPU 8GB $0.00125/min on Ubicloud vs $0.00600/min on GitHub' and 'Burstable VMs start at $10.47/month', quoted

shape.note: the standard-2 runner: 2 vCPU, 8 GB and 40 GB of block storage

session_cap.note: a runner exists for the job and is billed by the minute; burstable VMs start at $10.47 a month

extras.price_note: a VPS bills by the month with an hourly rate capped at the monthly figure, so the two columns answer two questions: destroying the box between runs versus keeping it up.
extras.price_basis: 10 h/day column = 300 h at the hourly rate, which is what a server destroyed between runs costs; 24/7 column = the monthly cap, because a VPS kept up all month stops at the cap.

net.ports: a public IPv4 address is included with the runner
